name: Local ethnic nationalism
notAnIdeology: A label, first used by Mao Zedong and repeated by Deng Xiaoping, that the Chinese Communist Party applies to non-Han and regional nationalisms (Taiwanese, Uyghur, Tibetan, Mongol, Korean) to condemn them as deviations; the article describes no shared positions, and the groups it covers hold opposing views on most statements, so it is not one set of political beliefs adherents hold. The general positions are covered by ethnic nationalism.
